prompt: Create an original 180 second bossa nova instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: nylon guitar, shaker, upright bass, electric piano. Style: syncopated guitar chords with gentle Latin groove. Tempo approximately 102 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A gentle and relaxing acoustic piece featuring fingerpicked guitar, soft piano chords, a steady bassline, and light brush drums. It creates a calm and peaceful atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首轻柔放松的器乐作品，以指弹吉他、柔和的钢琴和弦、稳定的贝斯线和轻柔的鼓点为特色。营造出平静祥和的氛围。
